items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: George McCullum worked at the Cotton Exchange every day and played the Jitna dance every night. I do know that.

ctx.x: But who's gonna hire you for a week? I don't know how he did it.

George McCullum worked at the Cotton Exchange every day and played the Jitna dance every night. I do know that. Lots of them did it, you know, right at home, but not on the road every night. How could you hold a job in there and on the road every night? That's impossible.
